sourceDecisionQuestions.question: The source distinguishes nailing strip/franja from nailing zone/zona. Archived bande and zone may be product-specific marks rather than interchangeable. Confirm the exact product marking and dictionary senses before selecting location commands.

Fastener, asphalt shingle, sealant strip and tab have component-specific meanings. Archived fixation, bardeau, bande adhésive and patte need qualified regional/trade review so a deck or dictionary entry does not conflate materials or components.

The source depicts a foreman using a nail gun and giving a corrective demonstration. Product nailing zone, repair method, fastener pattern and power-tool controls are not specified. Keep the archived imperatives and demonstration out of scored/audio commands until qualified product and safety review.

Archived speaking says stop the course, show the manufacturer's zone and ask for approved correction; those are additional steps beyond the source speaking objective. Preserve the current source request and record the extra scene only as review evidence.
